response.sql: WITH race_wins AS (SELECT c.country, cs.wins - COALESCE(LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year ORDER BY r.round, r.raceId), 0) AS wins_gained FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained * 1.0) AS avg_wins FROM race_wins GROUP BY country), all_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS value FROM country_averages), above_average AS (SELECT ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am WHERE ca.avg_wins > am.value), above_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS value FROM above_average) SELECT AVG(aa.avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(aa.avg_wins - am.value) AS mean_excess_over_all_countries, AVG(aa.avg_wins - bm.value) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_countries FROM above_average AS aa CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am CROSS JOIN above_mean AS bm WHERE aa.avg_wins > bm.value
